text.tspan: This is the piano secret room
Something feels fake about this room.
Like this is where the demons want the
book. Every time I try to burn it, it turns
up again in this room. Somehow, the
demons keep bringing it here. If I am the
only one who knows about it, this means
they only want me to know about it,
which is a little bit concerning.
